title: Functionality and Data Stealing by Pseudo-Client Attack and Target Defenses in Split Learning
motivation: Semi-honest server wants to steal client functionality to avoid revenue sharing in split learning partnerships
problem_framing: Enable server to steal functionality, reconstruct inputs, infer labels without knowing client model structure in split learning
key_insight: A well-trained server model contains sufficient knowledge to construct a pseudo-client model using very limited samples, even without smashed data
method_signature: Train pseudo-client model using evolving server models as learning targets via knowledge distillation; label alignment boosts attack
evaluation_criteria: Functionality gap measured by inference accuracy decrease; input reconstruction quality; label inference accuracy
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: UnSplit only works for client top model with one layer; existing attacks suffer from large search space when models are deep
evidence_for_taste: steal the functionality of the client model
large search space of both possible inputs
server can add noise to the smashed data
the feature space of smashed data
thinking_moves: 从已知服务器模型反推未知客户端模型的可能性
把模型反演问题转化为知识蒸馏问题
观察中间模型比最终模型提供更多信息
标签对齐作为攻击增强手段
防御思路：制造标签不一致来破坏攻击前提
